paragraphs: The University of Kent is a public research university based in Canterbury, England, founded in 1965. Known as 'The UK's European university' for its strong links across Europe, Kent is part of the prestigious E16 universities network and is the largest research university in Kent. Kent has a long-standing reputation in Law (Kent Law School), Mathematics, Business (Kent Business School — Triple Crown accredited), Sciences, Architecture, and Humanities. Main campus is in Canterbury on a 300-acre site overlooking the cathedral, with a second campus in Medway.

International students enter via the Oxford International pathway programmes at the University of Kent — International Foundation, International Year One, and Pre-Master courses lead directly into Kent Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
paragraphsRu: University of Kent — государственный исследовательский университет в Кентербери (Англия), основан в 1965 году. Известен как "The UK's European university" благодаря тесным связям с Европой. Сильные направления — Law (Kent Law School), математика, бизнес (Kent Business School — Triple Crown), естественные науки, архитектура, гуманитарные. Главный кампус — 300 акров в Кентербери с видом на собор, второй — в Medway.

Международные студенты заходят через pathway-программы Oxford International в University of Kent — International Foundation, International Year One и Pre-Master ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Kent.
